probes.label: Quantile logLik
probes.detail: logLik is not available for Quantile: the check loss is not a log-likelihood: it targets a conditional quantile with no distributional assumption behind it. Compare fits by cross-validated risk (cvrisk) at the same tau. Use negative_risk() if the value you want is the quantity the fit minimised, negated.
